name: outlook-calendar
description: Microsoft 365 (Outlook) calendar integration via Microsoft Graph — list, create, update, and delete calendar events and list calendars for a mailbox. Uses app-only (client-credentials) auth and works with Microsoft 365 work/school accounts.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Microsoft 365 calendar events via Microsoft Graph (app-only)

fields.label: Directory (Tenant) ID
fields.helpText: The Azure AD tenant ID (GUID) of your Microsoft 365 organization.

fields.label: Application (Client) ID
fields.helpText: The Application (client) ID of the app registration.

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.helpText: A client secret for the app registration. Requires the Calendars.ReadWrite application permission with admin consent.

fields.label: User (UPN/email)
fields.helpText: The mailbox to operate on (app-only requires an explicit user).

tools.name: outlook.list_events
tools.description: List calendar events for the user. If start and end are given, returns events in that window (calendar view, expanding recurrences); otherwise returns upcoming events.

start.description: Start of window (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-07-15T00:00:00Z). Requires end.

end.description: End of window (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-07-16T00:00:00Z). Requires start.

tools.name: outlook.create_event
tools.description: Create a new calendar event in the user's default calendar.

timeZone.description: IANA/Windows time zone for start and end (default UTC)

tools.name: outlook.update_event
tools.description: Update fields of an existing calendar event.

tools.name: outlook.delete_event
tools.description: Delete a calendar event. This is not easily reversible.

tools.name: outlook.list_calendars
tools.description: List the calendars in the user's mailbox.
